title: Czech quality reasons
summary: The admin explains a failed quality check in Czech, built from the stored numbers and thresholds, e.g. "Neprošla: jen 6 odpovědí má aspoň 2 hlasy (potřeba 8)" or "Rajčata má 78 % hlasů (nejvýš 45 %)". The gate also records an explicit offensive flag for future runs.
tradeoffs: Games generated before this change carry no offensive flag, so that one reason can only appear for new games.
